texts.zh: [shroudwalker_system.GetName]恒星系的大胜利！我们的军队快刀斩乱麻地解决了那些所谓的[FROM.GetName]秘术师。尽管成天对知识和力量夸夸其谈，他们对虚境的愚蠢奉献还是没能预先料知到我们的攻击。事实上，我们的军队很轻易地就破坏了设施的机械化防御。然而，在进入之后，他们发现整个太空城邦人去楼空，只有一个孤独的侍僧在一个偏僻的房室里面进行冥想。剩下的人去了哪里，我们无从得知，但是整个星系这下摆脱了这种空洞的教条。
texts.en: Victory in the [shroudwalker_system.GetName] system! Our forces made short work of the so-called mystics of the [FROM.GetName]. For all the grand talk of knowledge and power, their foolish devotion to the Shroud could not provide clairvoyance enough to forestall our assault. In fact, our forces easily breached the facility's mechanical defenses. However, once inside, they discovered the enclave empty, save for a lone acolyte they found deep in meditation in a remote chamber. Where the rest have gone, we have no idea, but the galaxy is well rid of such hollow dogma.

texts.zh: 传达的报告主要围绕着[shroudwalker_system.GetName]恒星系发生的[FROM.GetName]的毁灭。侵略者在这次行动中十分迅速，将虚境行者的设施化为一片断壁残垣。很难相信这些秘术大师没有预料到自身的消亡。还是说，这场悲剧仅仅只是某个更庞大计划的一部分？谁又能说得准呢？不过，没有他们的效劳，未来仍然充满重重迷雾。
texts.en: Reports are coming in surrounding the destruction of the [FROM.GetName] in the [shroudwalker_system.GetName] system. The aggressors made short work of the campaign, reducing the Shroudwalkers' facilities to rubble. It is strange to think that these mystics could not foresee their own demise. Or could this tragedy be a part of some still grander design? Who can say? Without their services, the future remains shrouded.

summary.text:
# 虚境行者城邦被毁 / Shroudwalker Enclave Destroyed

- 分类 Category：巨兽与城邦 · DLC：霸主 Overlord
- 来源 Sources：events/overlord_enclaves_events.txt:7493（enclave.430）, :7535（enclave.435）, :7564（enclave.440）; events/observer_events.txt:1605（observer.95）; common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1425
- 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-12（C6）

## 如何开始 How it starts
虚境行者城邦空间站被击毁时（on_ship_destroyed_victim → 隐藏 enclave.430）。When the Shroudwalker station is destroyed.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline
按视角收到一种通知（互斥）：摧毁者 enclave.435——攻入后发现城邦几乎人去楼空，只剩一名冥想中的侍僧；其他有通讯的帝国 enclave.440；观察者 observer.95。同时所有帝国的“泽珞什一税”修正被移除（:7527–7529）。
One notice per viewpoint: the destroyer (enclave.435) finds the station almost empty save one meditating acolyte; others in contact get enclave.440; observers observer.95. Every empire's Zro tithe modifier is removed.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

本导读未单列分支与结局；分支随各事件在上文说明，互斥结果在阅读器中以“择一”框显示。/ This guide does not list branches separately; they are described with each event above, and exclusive outcomes are boxed in the reader.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

本导读未单列条件差异；条件随各事件在上文说明，阅读器按文明设定显示可能的版本。/ This guide does not list conditions separately; they are described with each event above, and the reader shows the possible variants for the chosen empire profile.

## 审阅记录 Review notes
已核对接收者与效果。覆盖完整。Coverage complete.
（评注：435 中“其余成员去向不明”为原文，本档案不作推测。Commentary: where the others went is left unexplained in the source.）
